scope: Actual Node-hosted Pyodide shared-extension smoke, including supplied loop transport. Full gg-to-Hg coefficients/amplitudes and browser DOM/UI acceptance are separate gates.

build.native_host_compiler_override: HOST_CC and HOST_AR captured before Pyodide supplies target CC and AR

gates: Published owners compiled for wasm32-unknown-emscripten; target graph excludes GMP, MPFR, native code generation and RustRed.
Native generated integration stub in wheel exactly matches validated source artifact; Python3.9 syntax retained.
Automatic-boundary capability false and native-only classes/methods absent; both canonical Higgs systems expose all eight configurations.
Supplied scalar epsilon/(1+x) transport checked against log(2) through epsilon^2 at requested20digits.
Nonzero rounded415-bit seed and all derived values/errors/per-number precision survive binary cache reload exactly.
Stored bank evidence unchanged on restart; selected-source accuracy cap and cache-hit provenance checked separately.
Exact repeated hit, intermediate-point insertion, nearby-source reuse and transactional pre-cancellation passed.
Existing algebra, symbolic integration, offline48-diagram/native-rendering, HEPKit, NumPy tensor and Symanzik checks passed.
Restricted WebAssembly export inventory:170exports, only PyInit_core/__wasm_call_ctors/__wasm_apply_data_relocs functions.
Successful smoke emitted a capability marker tied to the installed wheel SHA256.

resolved_failures.description: Pyodide target CC was incorrectly used for the x86_64 BLAKE3 build dependency. Explicit native HOST_CC/HOST_AR fixed the build without changing dependency sources.

micropip considered the existing Symbolica wheel satisfied and did not install newly requested NumPy extras. Core returned a list without NumPy; inherited Spenso tensor wrapping expects ndarray.tolist. Final smoke explicitly installs the declared NumPy dependency. No claim of no-NumPy tensor-evaluator support; no owner source patch.

cache_contract: Version8 owner bincode numeric payload; source/dependency/feature fingerprints remain enforced. Portable supplied seeds are imported through the admitted API, not through foreign binary-cache reuse.
limits: No full gg-to-Hg scientific or browser UI timing claim from this smoke.
Compiler RSS is one observed sample, not a measured peak.
